announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: As a micro-cap AIM listing with historically low liquidity and limited analyst coverage, this interim results release is routine for shareholders but carries moderate information asymmetry risk; the market reaction will likely be muted unless there are significant deviations from consensus on cash flow or debt covenants.

announcements.headline: Annual Report for the Year Ended 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: As a standard annual report filing for a micro-cap entity, this announcement lacks the transformative catalysts required to move the market significantly, reflecting routine compliance rather than strategic shift.
